title: Verse Account of Nabonidus — English translation on Livius.org
license: Translation after Oppenheim in ANET; paraphrased only

verification_log.method: Col. ii 5–6: Nabonidus gave the army to his eldest son and "entrusted the kingship to him", then went to Tayma, killed its prince and built a palace there; col. iv lacuna has "the king is mad"; cols. iv–vi praise Cyrus

access_notes: Page gives no museum number. The text is hostile to Nabonidus and favourable to Cyrus.
